'''Sour cherry soup''' is a slightly sweet [[soup]] made with [[sour cream]], [[sugar]] and whole fresh [[Prunus cerasus|sour cherries]], and served chilled.<ref>{{cite web | last=Novakovich | first=Mary | title=What to eat in Hungary: Your guide to goulash and more | publisher=CNN Travel | date=November 22, 2013 | url=https://www.cnn.com/travel/article/hungarian-food/index.html | access-date=August 25, 2018}}</ref> Originating in [[Hungarian cuisine]], this soup is a summer delicacy in several [[European cuisine]]s.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.tasteatlas.com/meggyleves|title=Meggyleves}}</ref>

The dish has been adopted by the [[Austrians]], [[Polish people|Poles]], [[Slovaks]], and [[Germans]]. [[Hungarian-American]]s and [[Hungarian-Canadian]]s brought the soup to North America.<ref name="Meyers">June Meyers, ''Authentic Hungarian Heirloom Recipes''</ref>

In Hungarian cuisine, sour cherry soup<ref name="Meyers" /> or ''meggyleves''<ref>{{cite web | title=Johanna Konta caps unlikely run with Miami Open crown | website=miamiherald | date=March 1, 2017 | url=https://www.miamiherald.com/sports/tennis/article142197654.html | access-date=August 25, 2018}}</ref> is a soup made from the fruits of the sour cherry tree (''Prunus cerasus''), and not from sweet cherries. The name is formed from <!-- ''hideg'' meaning 'cold', --> {{lang|hu|meggy}} 'sour cherries,' and {{lang|hu|leves}} meaning 'soup.' It is traditionally served as a dinner course, usually as either the [[appetizer]],<ref>{{cite web | title=Hungarian Sour Cherry Soup -- Hideg Meggyleves | website=Daily Herald | date=February 4, 2015 | url=https://www.dailyherald.com/article/20150204/entlife/150209860/ | access-date=August 25, 2018}}</ref> [[soup]] or [[dessert]], on warm summer nights or for hot summer luncheons. The soup is cooked with whole sour cherries, including the pits. Sour cherry trees are numerous in [[Hungary]], and the soup is a good example of the quintessentially Hungarian fusion of Eastern/Asian influences and traditional [[Continental Europe]]an cuisine. It is customary that the soup contains fresh sour cherries, fresh cream and sometimes [[cloves]] and [[cinnamon]]. Canned regular cherries are sometimes added and sour cream is often substituted for fresh cream. A small amount of sweet white or dry red [[wine]] is also sometimes added before serving. Packets of dried {{lang|hu|meggyleves}} powder are also sold in Hungary.
